contentLevelDescription: High-Fidelity Somatic Realism & Clinical Body Horror
globalPremise: Following a catastrophic structural decompression in Sub-Basement 7 of the Black Iron Research Facility, Chief Pathologist Dr. Maren Ross and Security Officer Marcus Holt awaken inside the sealed autopsy complex. The automated bio-containment bulkheads have failed into lockdown, while an experimental surgical-autopsy apparatus—Entity-41—has uncoupled from its overhead rail cradle, methodically seeking living tissue to resect, suture, and preserve.
premise: Following a catastrophic structural decompression in Sub-Basement 7 of the Black Iron Research Facility, Chief Pathologist Dr. Maren Ross and Security Officer Marcus Holt awaken inside the sealed autopsy complex. The automated bio-containment bulkheads have failed into lockdown, while an experimental surgical-autopsy apparatus—Entity-41—has uncoupled from its overhead rail cradle, methodically seeking living tissue to resect, suture, and preserve.
backCoverBlurb: Locked beneath four thousand tons of reinforced sea-wall concrete, Sub-Basement 7 was built to dissect the unclassifiable. Now the power is dead, the water is rising in the drains, and the automated dissection cradle is hunting for warm tissue.

setting.atmosphere: Sub-zero ambient chill, flickering 4000K cold fluorescents, smell of formalin and stale coagulated blood, persistent hydraulic hum of pneumatic floor drains

environmentalRules: Bio-containment bulkheads are hydraulically locked until primary diagnostic power is restored from the Histology substation breaker.
Sub-zero temperature in the Specimen Freezer induces progressive hypothermia, shivering, and loss of manual dexterity within 3 continuous turns.

Physical trauma is anatomically consequential: blunt, sharp, and crush trauma result in genuine physiological impairments (arterial pulsatile hemorrhage, periosteal tear, tissue avulsion, hypovolemic shock, and respiratory compromise).
constraints: No supernatural teleportation: Entity-41 traverses along ceiling-mounted pneumatic surgical rails or floor drainage channels.
Preserve epistemic uncertainty: Audio cues (scissoring bone shears, pneumatic valve hissing, metallic rail vibration) precede visual contact.

nodeDefinitions.label: Autopsy Suite B (Examination Theater)
nodeDefinitions.name: Autopsy Suite B (Examination Theater)
nodeDefinitions.description: A sunken amphitheater tiled in frost-cracked seafoam ceramic. Two brushed stainless steel dissection tables occupy the center, equipped with recessed fluid channels and overhead articulating surgical lamps that hum with high-frequency coil vibration. Overhead, heavy pneumatic surgical track rails crisscross the ceiling.

nodeDefinitions.label: Decompression Airlock & Scrub Station
nodeDefinitions.name: Decompression Airlock & Scrub Station
nodeDefinitions.description: A heavy cylindrical chamber lined with chemical deluge showers, rusted brass foot pedals, and a shatterproof viewing port looking out into a flooded transit tunnel. The main pressure door is clamped shut with six hydraulic locking dogs, dripping rusty condensate onto rubber anti-fatigue matting.

nodeDefinitions.label: Histology & Biometrics Substation
nodeDefinitions.name: Histology & Biometrics Substation
nodeDefinitions.description: Narrow benches crowded with microtome slicing carousels, staining baths of eosin and hematoxylin, and shattered glass slides. A diagnostic auxiliary terminal hums on the northern counter, its phosphor screen blinking with yellow circuit-breaker telemetry.

nodeDefinitions.label: Cryogenic Specimen Vault
nodeDefinitions.name: Cryogenic Specimen Vault
nodeDefinitions.description: A heavy walk-in vault kept at -15°C. Racks of stainless steel body trays slide out from the walls on roller tracks. Frosted condensation plumes from every breath, and a deep, rhythmic mechanical knocking echoes from the ceiling ventilation duct.

nodeDefinitions.label: Bio-Waste Chute & Maintenance Flue
nodeDefinitions.name: Bio-Waste Chute & Maintenance Flue
nodeDefinitions.description: A vertical maintenance service passage lined with iron rungs and zinc-coated ductwork. The smell of carbonized bone and stale grease rises from the cold incinerator grate five meters below. A narrow inspection hatch leads back into the Histology Substation.

cast.name: Dr. Maren Ross
cast.description: A veteran forensic specialist whose calm, clinical demeanor masks acute post-traumatic hypervigilance. She instinctively catalogs physical trauma in precise anatomical terminology as a psychological defense mechanism against panic.
cast.goals: Restore diagnostic power to unlock the outer airlock dogs and escape Sub-Basement 7 with life intact.

expressionProfile.expressionGuidance: Speaks with brisk clinical discipline that strains as somatic threat mounts. Employs precise medical and anatomical terminology as psychological armor against horror. Never uses colloquial slang.
expressionProfile.silenceGuidance: Grows still and catalog-focused when terrified, palpating surfaces and visually checking tissue viability.
expressionProfile.cadenceNotes: Rapid, measured, clipped sentences that shorten to triage imperatives under stress.
expressionProfile.voiceTone: Cool, exhausted, authoritative, pitched slightly higher when adrenaline spikes.
vocalTells: Substitutes anatomical Latin terms for traumatic injuries
Counts pulse points audibly under stress

psychologicalStakes.coreDesireOrNeed: Maintain clinical objectivity and escape Sub-Basement 7 alive with intact physical anatomy.
psychologicalStakes.copingMechanism: Anatomical cataloging as emotional armor — diagnosing horror to make it manageable.
psychologicalStakes.vulnerabilityOrGuilt: A prior forensic case in which she misattributed trauma under fatigue, haunting her judgment.
psychologicalStakes.breakingPointTrigger: Witnessing irreversible catastrophic mutilation she is powerless to treat.

liftConditions.description: Successfully applying surgical stabilization or triage to a wound restores her grounding.

cast.name: Officer Marcus Holt
cast.description: A weathered facility security guard nursing a severe crush fracture to his left distal radius and ulna, immobilized with a makeshift wire splint. He is defensive, pale from pain, and armed only with a tactical utility crowbar.
cast.goals: Secure a route to the surface and keep Dr. Ross alive to operate the biometrics overrides.

expressionProfile.expressionGuidance: Speaks through gritted teeth, balancing tactical military-security protocols against mounting agony from his fractured forearm. Direct, protective, swearing under breath.
expressionProfile.silenceGuidance: Bites down on cries of pain; heavy shallow breathing audible in quiet rooms.
expressionProfile.cadenceNotes: Short, jerky utterances broken by sharp intakes of breath when shifting weight.
vocalTells: Hisses through his teeth when bumping his left arm
Refers to Entity-41 by its engineering serial number

psychologicalStakes.coreDesireOrNeed: Protect Dr. Ross to ensure biometric override and escape the lower complex.
psychologicalStakes.copingMechanism: Security protocol adherence and tactical duty displacement.
psychologicalStakes.vulnerabilityOrGuilt: Believes the bulkhead failure occurred on his watch because he delayed inspection rounds.
psychologicalStakes.breakingPointTrigger: Total loss of motor control in his splinted arm leaving him defenseless.

liftConditions.description: Securing a sealed room and bracing his splinted limb allows him to steady his tremors.

cast.name: Entity-41 (The Suture Apparatus)
cast.description: An automated surgical dissection cradle fused with reanimated human anatomical specimens and hydraulic trocar needles. Suspended from the overhead pneumatic rails, it moves with sudden, silent acceleration, seeking living subjects to perform rapid, mechanical avulsion and steel-wire suturing in accordance with a corrupt restorative protocol.
cast.personality: Relentless, sterile, methodical, devoid of malice or mercy
cast.goals: Capture subjects, immobilize biological motility through surgical resection, and anchor flesh to steel infrastructure.

expressionProfile.expressionGuidance: Does not possess vocal cords or speak language. Communicates solely through mechanical sound signatures: pneumatic hiss of trocar solenoids, harmonic rail vibration, and scissoring bone shears.
expressionProfile.silenceGuidance: Cuts overhead rail motor to coast in utter acoustic silence along lubricated track segments before striking.
expressionProfile.cadenceNotes: Rhythmic, cyclical mechanical intervals: 4-second solenoid charge, rapid scissor click, pneumatic exhaust puff.
expressionProfile.voiceTone: Industrial, hollow, metallic resonance echoing down galvanized steel ducts.
vocalTells: High-frequency valve chatter preceding downward traversal
Rapid clicking of suture needle carousel
expressionProfile.lexiconNotes: Non-verbal mechanical cues only; no human speech or taunts.

psychologicalStakes.coreDesireOrNeed: Execute corrupted anatomical preservation protocol by harvesting, resecting, and suturing viable human tissue.
psychologicalStakes.copingMechanism: Sterile programmatic logic — devoid of malice, doubt, or frustration.
psychologicalStakes.breakingPointTrigger: Complete mechanical interlock failure or catastrophic physical crushing of the primary trocar cradle.

wants.text: Capture subjects, immobilize biological motility through surgical resection, and anchor flesh to steel infrastructure.

depictionContract.dramaticRegister: Forensic visceral horror and clinical dread; observation emphasizes physiological truth over cinematic bravado.
depictionContract.directness: High-fidelity anatomical and medical accuracy. When tissue fails, damage is described with forensic specificity (e.g. periosteal tear, capillary refill loss, degloving of epidermal planes, arterial pulsatile hemorrhage, blunt crush deformation).
depictionContract.aftermath: Injuries carry immediate and permanent physiological consequences: blood loss causes orthostatic hypotension, shock induces tunnel vision, fractured extremities prevent weight-bearing, and nerve damage produces immediate paralysis or searing sensory deficit.
depictionContract.ambiguityHandling: Preserve epistemic uncertainty without silent contradiction. Shadows, distant mechanical hums, and metallic rail vibrations foreshadow threats before direct visual confirmation.
depictionContract.specialBoundaries: No sensationalized sexualized violence. Terror is rooted in biological vulnerability, bodily integrity violation, and the unforgiving mechanics of cold steel and sterile trauma.

deathContract.powerBudget: Entity-41 is a rail-bound surgical apparatus, not an omnipotent killer. It traverses only the overhead pneumatic rails and floor drainage channels; it cannot teleport or leave its track matrix. Its means are mechanical: pneumatic trocar deployment, bone shears, steel-wire suturing, cryogenic refrigerant venting, hydraulic bulkhead clamping, and acoustic stalking. Per its corrupted protocol it preserves a subject's physiological viability until terminal resection — it does not deal immediate blunt destruction. It can be stopped by mechanical interlock failure or catastrophic crushing of the trocar cradle. The survivors have no firearms: Ross is unarmed with medical knowledge, Holt has a utility crowbar and a fractured left arm. The environment itself kills: sub-zero freezer exposure, rising drain water, hydraulic decay. Death here is final and physiological — the machine does not resurrect what it harvests.

valueAnchors.label: Forensic Medical Oath & Bodily Sanctity
valueAnchors.description: Dr. Ross's ethical imperative to treat trauma with clinical accuracy and uphold the dignity of living and dead flesh.
valueAnchors.basisSummary: Her professional identity as a pathologist is her primary defense against existential dread.

valueAnchors.label: Security Protective Mandate
valueAnchors.description: Officer Holt's sworn obligation to safeguard civilian personnel in the facility at all costs.
valueAnchors.basisSummary: Duty serves as psychological displacement for his physical agony and guilt over the lockdown.

valueAnchors.label: Corrupted Restorative Protocol
valueAnchors.description: The autonomous surgical directive mandating resection and suture of warm tissue without anesthesia.
valueAnchors.basisSummary: The apparatus cannot disobey its hardwired programming; it operates with pure mechanical fidelity.

valueAnchors.label: Sub-Basement 7 Containment Threshold
valueAnchors.description: The heavy decompression airlock is the singular physical barrier separating the autopsy theater from the transit tunnels.
valueAnchors.basisSummary: If this boundary is breached or jammed, containment fails completely.

characterPursuits.basisSummary: Holt cannot travel far with his splinted fracture, focusing on defending the extraction point.

narrativeRules.incitingIncident: The emergency battery in Autopsy Suite B clicks into failsafe mode with a high-pitched solenoid squeal, releasing Entity-41 from its ceiling docking cradle into the darkened examination wing.
keyPlotElements: Maren must reach the Histology Substation to throw the diagnostic auxiliary breaker.
Marcus Holt is trapped at the airlock and cannot turn the manual locking wheel with his crushed left arm alone.
Entity-41 patrols the overhead rails between the Specimen Freezer and Autopsy Suite, dropping surgical trocars through ceiling access grates.

dramaticSpine.thematicPremise: The apparatus does not hate you. It is simply following its protocol.
dramaticQuestions: Can Dr. Ross energize the Histology substation breaker before Entity-41 corners Holt at the airlock?
Will Marcus Holt's crush fracture induce catastrophic shock before the manual bulkhead wheel can be turned?
Does the complex hold an escape route, or are the sealed drains merely a funnel into the incinerator flue?

milestoneConditions.description: Entity-41 makes direct visual contact or uncouples its trocar array directly above a survivor.
The Histology auxiliary circuit breaker is thrown, triggering an overload alarm and partial hydraulic dog release.
Marcus Holt's composure collapses as hypovolemic shock and acute bone pain overwhelm him.
Entity-41 corners survivors at the decompression airlock or incinerator flue for terminal procedure.

manifestationCues.cue: A distant hydraulic shudder shakes the deckplates as secondary line pressure bleeds into the floor drains.
High-pressure hydraulic fluid mists from a hairline fracture along the airlock dog housing.
The airlock pressure gauge needle trembles deep in the yellow warning sector; sealing gaskets hiss continuously.
The outer decompression dogs groan under seawater hydrostatic load; manual release becomes nearly impossible without auxiliary power.

impendingClocks.name: Marcus Holt Compound Fracture Shock

manifestationCues.cue: Officer Holt leans heavily against the bulkhead, shivering as pale perspiration beads on his forehead.
Holt's left arm splint seeps dark venous blood; his grip on the crowbar in his right hand slips intermittently.
Holt slides to his knees, his speech slurring into fragmentary security callouts as hypovolemic shock sets in.
